messages:
marco: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the reliability incident — sharing the RCA and action plan links.
marco: RCA (long-form): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RCA-INC-2026-03-14
marco: Short TL;DR: a cascade in the policy router + an overly broad fallback policy caused degraded routing for hosted API traffic for ~6 hours. We missed circuit-breaker thresholds.
olivia: Thanks for posting. Can you confirm whether the router rewrite is still the long-term fix you mentioned in the Q&A?
jordan: Yes — rewrite + safer defaults. Short-term: rolling hotfix to router config + KV eviction tuning, target EOD next Wed for hotfix push. Owner: @jordan.
sumit: For SLOs: do we plan to update the error budget burn policy while the rewrite is in progress?
marco: Good call. We will tighten alerting and pause aggressive auto-scaling changes until the rewrite is validated. Owner for SLO review: @sumit.
kelly: PMs — do you need a customer-facing blurb? I can help prep.
sara: I'll draft a customer-facing blurb and circulate for review by tomorrow 10:00 PT. Owner: @sara.
jamal: Can you share the specific rollback plan if the hotfix causes regressions?
jordan: Rollback plan: immediate kill switch on router pool, route to secondary region; canary split 5% -> 25% over 2 hours, monitoring on p50/p95/p99, and automations to revert on error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. Details in the tracking ticket: https://go/rdw/INC-2026-router
alex: Will Dedicated customers be impacted by this hotfix?
jordan: Not by the hotfix — Dedicated uses a separate router pool. We'll schedule equivalent config tests for Dedicated next week.
marco: Action items from AH (restating):
- RCA link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RCA-INC-2026-03-14
- Hotfix & canary plan: owner @jordan, ETA: Wed EOD (tracking ticket above)
- Fallback policy short-term change: owner @olivia, roll out today to widen fallback window to 10s
- SLO and alerting review: owner @sumit, deliverable: updated alert thresholds + runbook
- Customer comms blurb: owner @sara, draft by tomorrow 10:00 PT
- Follow-up sync: Mon 09:30 PT #eng-sre (calendar invite sent)
marco: Please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept an owner, or :eyes: if you're supporting.
olivia: :white_check_mark:
jordan: :white_check_mark:
sara: :white_check_mark:
sumit: :eyes:
kelly: :eyes:
jamal: Quick perf Q: widening fallback to 10s — do we expect p99 latency to shift much?
jordan: Microbenchmarks: p99 ~+1.5% for the routed path; plan includes load tests during the canary window.
olivia: I'll add the immediate config diff to the RCA doc and tag owners.
team-bot: Reminder: RCA assigned to owners; internal deadline set to 2026-04-01. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RCA-INC-2026-03-14
eng-oncall-bot: Use `/inc logs INC-2026` for raw logs or DM @eng-oncall for access.
jamal: Can we post a 1-paragraph status to #all-hands after the Monday sync so stakeholders see progress?
marco: Yes — I'll publish a concise update after Monday's sync.
olivia: Adding action items to RCA now. Ping me if you spot anything missing.
marco: Appreciated. If anyone wants to join the postmortem deep dive, reply here and we'll add you to the invite.
alex: Would like to join the deep dive.
marco: Adding @alex. Thanks all.
